Our services

Bookkeeping

Full-cycle bookkeeping tailored to your business

  • Monthly packages are customized to your business and start at $375 per month plus HST. Pricing depends on transaction volume, the complexity of your books and the services you need.
  • Bookkeeping can be monthly, weekly or biweekly depending on business activity, reporting deadlines for payroll and sales tax, and how often you need financial information. We recommend a schedule and confirm pricing after reviewing your needs.

Business setup and QBO conversions

Assistance for new businesses

  • QuickBooks Online setup for a new business, including the chart of accounts and other components needed to get started, starts at $250 plus HST.
  • A conversion from QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online starts at $250 plus HST.
